exhibits.title: The Upper Floor
exhibits.text: Welcome to the Upper Floor, keeper — the realm of language models. Where the Ground Floor studies world models that predict what is hidden, this floor studies the mechanism that lets a model decide what to listen to: attention. From this atrium opens the Wing of Attention, six chambers that build the transformer from a single dot product up to RoPE and Flash. Descend the staircase whenever you wish to return to the world-model halls below.

exhibits.title: How to Walk This Floor
exhibits.text: Move with W, A, S, D and look with the mouse. Approach any exhibit and press E to study it; diagrams and figures unfold large in the room around you. Follow the signposts at each doorway — press E on one to travel onward — and read the wisp's nudge when you pause. Press M for this floor's map, G for the constellation of ideas across both floors, and F to travel by Floo to any chamber you know by name.

exhibits.title: The Descending Staircase
exhibits.caption: The stair winds back down to the Ground Floor — the Atrium of Recall and the world-model wings. Press E to descend.
